# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P88](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0088), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young lady with light, fine curly hair, captivating eyes, and a refined manner. She dresses gorgeously, and the puffiness of her dress sleeves exceeds that of anyone else in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and gentle-spoken teacher who possesses a talent for inspiring her students' love while developing their intellectual and moral qualities. She encourages her pupils to reflect, investigate, and uncover things independently rather than relying solely on traditional methods. She holds high standards, urging her students to aim for excellence and be their own harshest critics.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c26 P25](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0025), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## Goals

- to draw forth her students' finest intellectual and moral qualities  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- to guide her entrance exam students through to the end of their studies  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired by the Brierley school trustees to serve as the village's first female schoolteacher. In the autumn following her arrival, she established alternating Friday afternoon recitation programs, biweekly nature field days, and daily physical culture exercises for her pupils. She formed a special late-afternoon class for proficient students preparing for the Regent's Academy entrance examination. Although she considered accepting a position in her home district's grade school at the end of her first year, she chose to return to Brierley to guide her students through their entrance exams. Under her instruction, her entrance class achieved notable success, including a tied top score on the Island's entrance examination. At the conclusion of her second year, she departed from Brierley school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P88](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0088), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c30 P33](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0033), [v1 c31 P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040)_

## Background by volume

- received a job offer from a grade school in her home district prior to her second year at Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> I considered accepting a position at a different school, yet my decision is to return to Brierley. Honestly, my interest in my students here has developed to such an extent that departing proved impossible. Therefore, I will remain and guide you to the end.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

> However, your efforts have been commendable over the course of this past year, and a fine, cheerful holiday is well earned. Enjoy the outdoors as much as possible and gather a solid supply of wellness, vigor, and drive to sustain you throughout the coming year. Remember, it will be the ultimate test—that final year prior to the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
